turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need a new winter coat. My old one has a broken zipper.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it. Are you thinking a long warm parka, or a shorter jacket that's easier to move in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I need to talk to Rosa real quick. Stay quiet until I return.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rosa, have you seen my charger? The white one with the short cable.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I borrowed it this morning, sorry. It's next to my bed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I grab it? I'm down to five percent.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Go for it. We really need to buy a second one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Agreed. Maybe a long cable so it reaches the couch.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Good idea. Add it to the shopping list.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Still deciding on the coat, long or short?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A shorter one, I bike to work most days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. Look for something windproof with a bit of stretch so you can move your arms easily.
